Assistant B provides the correct answer with sound reasoning: "car" is the odd one out because tyre, steering wheel, and engine are all component parts of a vehicle, whereas "car" refers to the complete vehicle itself. Assistant A incorrectly identifies "tyre" as the outlier and offers inconsistent logic—claiming that steering wheel and engine are "more general" terms than tyre, when in fact they are all equally specific parts of a car.
